intro: Vesprystus is the night elf flight master stationed at the docks of Rut'theran Village at the base of Teldrassil. He oversees the roost of trained hippogryphs that carry travelers between the great World Tree and mainland Kalimdor.

p: Perched at the southern base of Teldrassil in Rut'theran Village, Vesprystus tends the hippogryphs that bridge the isolated elven boughs to the rest of the world. While a magical portal connects Rut'theran directly to the canopy city of Darnassus above, hippogryph flights provide a swift crossing toward Darkshore and the mainland. Vesprystus works in coordination with the flight master at Auberdine across the strait, ensuring safe passage for sentinels, emissaries, and adventurers journeying into Kalimdor.
